description: This file defines the implementation of a logging configuration source interface, including JSON and file-based sources, with functions for creating, setting, getting, and closing configuration sources, as well as parsing JSON configurations.

classes.name: jsonSrc
classes.description: Implementation of LogConfigSrc interface for JSON-based logging configuration.

classes.name: fileSrc
classes.description: Implementation of LogConfigSrc interface for file-based logging configuration.

methods.name: NewLogConfigSrc
methods.description: Creates a new logging configuration source based on the provided DSN and store.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Fetches the current cached logger configuration.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Updates the logger configuration source with new data.

methods.name: GetType
methods.description: Returns the type of the configuration source (JSON or file).

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with the configuration source.
